title: Working with Text and Lists in Slides

activities.title: The 5-second test
activities.intro: Read the slide on the screen. You have only five seconds. Then answer here without looking back.

blocks.prompt: Type one rule you remember from that slide
Pick all the rules that were really on the slide.
options: Follow the agreed folder structure and naming convention
No personal photos, music or videos in the shared drive
The drive is backed up every Monday morning
Don't delete or move files without informing the section head
Save personal files on the desktop instead

activities.title: Turn a notice into 3 short bullets
activities.intro: Turn the 62-word workshop notice on the screen into a slide people can read in five seconds. Type your version here, in the chat, or as a new slide in your app.

items: Read the 62-word notice on the screen.
Write a title that says something.
Write 3 bullets, at most 6 words each.
Move anything extra to the speaker notes.

blocks.prompt: When and where is the workshop?
Which detail can move to the speaker notes?
options: Snacks are on the Admin Section

blocks.prompt: At most how many words should each bullet have?

help: Cut polite phrases like "Please be informed that". Keep nouns, verbs and numbers.
The test: someone glancing for five seconds knows when, where and what to bring.

blocks.prompt: PowerPoint shrank your 9 bullets to 14 pt so they fit. What's the best fix?
options: Make it 12 pt so it fits better
Cut to key words, split into two slides, move details to the notes
Change to a narrow, condensed font
Leave it; people can zoom in
